title: UIKit and SwiftUI Interoperability knowledge check

questions.prompt: What is the most direct learning goal for this lesson?
options: The main goal is to apply when uikit remains useful in a small Swift example and verify the result.

questions.answer_key: The main goal is to apply when uikit remains useful in a small Swift example and verify the result.
questions.explanation: UIKit and SwiftUI Interoperability is best learned through a small, verifiable example.
